description: Fixture- and request-side preconditions of the product check chain for actions a case expects to apply (step2r round 10, Step 2 closure review 7 and docs/execution/step2r-round10/precondition-audit.md). The product checks are read from the backend, never changed. ./verify prepare enforces them: ContractValidator.occurrenceTimeProblems (business clock, dispatch after its pick, delivery after its dispatch), grantAuthorityProblems (grant capability scope, delegator coverage, acting authority and grant place scope), commandBasisProblems (basis reference of dispatch and stock commands) and warehouseCustodyProblems (fixture stock reserved, picked, dispatched or moved at internal storage). contracts/fixture-place-kinds.json holds the place rules (dispatchTransit, transitReceipt, directReceiptCustody).
productRefs: backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/application/core/ApplicationCommands.java (apply: definition, handler prepare, fences, re-prepare, authorizeScopes, expectedRevision, CommandGuard.verify, execute, authorizeScopes again, verifyCommit)

backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/application/identity/IdentityAuthorization.java (permittedScopes: active membership; CapabilityAssignment of the capability; an active Grant with a GrantAction of the capability; every listed scope dimension matches the targets; a delegated grant requires the delegator to be permitted for the same capability and targets)

backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/application/inventory/FulfillmentCommands.java (reserve/replace/release/pick/dispatch order; dispatch: requireWarehouse, pickedAt, DISPATCH, transitPlaceId, PLACE authorization, requireContinuousAuthority: occurrence not after now and not before pickedAt, SELL and DISPATCH continuous from the occurrence to now, evidenceRef)

backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/domain/inventory/FulfillmentStockPrimitives.java (pick records pickedAt = the product clock and increments the allocation revision; observeDelivery rejects a delivery before the dispatch occurrence or after now)

backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/application/inventory/InventoryCommands.java (split/merge/move/stocktake/adjust/dispose: occurredAt not after now, evidenceRef required, source leaf not retired and valid at the occurrence, moveQuantity between distinct INTERNAL_STORAGE places of an internal custodian, destination PLACE authorization)
backend/src/main/java/com/mulino/application/core/ExecutionClock.java (one injected product clock; every DomainContext of a command has asOf = knownAt = that clock)

clock.meaning: The acceptance runtime runs the product on one controlled clock. It starts at the fixture clock asOf (the business instant of the installed facts; a fixture whose knownAt is later reads history at asOf with that knownAt) and moves only by clock controls. A clock control sets the clock to its parameters instant, else asOf, else knownAt. A runtime action's product instant (pickedAt, recordedAt) is the clock at that action.

occurrence.meaning: An action's business occurrence instant is its explicit occurredAt (slots or request), else the request asOf, else the clock at the action. The adapter derives it this way and never chooses another instant.
rules: An occurrence is never after the clock at its action (the product rejects a future actual occurrence).

A dispatchQuantity that is not pinned to a code decided before the time check (FORBIDDEN, STALE_REVISION, SCOPE_INELIGIBLE, VERSION_UNSUPPORTED) occurs at or after its pick: the clock at the earlier pickQuantity of the same allocation, or the fixture pickedAt of a picked fixture allocation.
A recordDelivery that is expected to apply and names a dispatch result occurs at or after that dispatch's occurrence.

grantAuthority.meaning: IdentityAuthorization intersects role, grant action, grant scope and the delegator's own authority. A fixture expresses them per actor: roleCapabilities, grant.actions, grant.scope and grant.delegatorAlias.
rules: A grant whose scope lists capabilityIds lists every grant action there (an installer would otherwise intersect or reject the grant).

A delegatorAlias that names another fixture actor names an actor whose roleCapabilities and grant.actions contain every action it delegates (plan section 7.1: a human delegator grants only within its own authority). A delegatorAlias that is no fixture actor is the fixture's root grantor; the installer installs it as an actor with a root grant covering what it delegates (Step 3 FixtureInstaller request).

A COMMAND or RECORD action a subcase expects to apply is performed by a fixture actor that holds the capability in roleCapabilities, grant.actions and grant.scope.capabilityIds when present, whose grant is valid at the clock of the action.

When the acting grant lists places (placeAliases or places), it includes every fixture place the product authorizes for the action: the segment place of a fixture segment that is reserved, split or moved, the segment place of a fixture allocation that is picked, dispatched, released or replaced, the destination of a move and the place of a confirmReceipt. A delegator that is a fixture actor and lists places includes them too.

commandBasis.meaning: dispatchQuantity and the stock commands require a basis reference (FulfillmentCommands and InventoryCommands text(slots,'evidenceRef')); plan section 4.2 '모든 명령은 ... 근거 ... 를 검증한다'. A command a subcase expects to apply names one: a non-empty request evidenceRefs, or an evidenceRef/evidenceId/evidenceIds/evidence field anywhere in its request (batch operations and blob business actions included). The adapter maps it to the product evidenceRef.

warehouseCustody.meaning: FulfillmentCommands.requireWarehouse (reserve, replace, dispatch) and InventoryCommands moveQuantity accept only stock at an INTERNAL_STORAGE place under an internal custodian (contracts/fixture-place-kinds.json). A fixture segment a subcase expects to reserve or move, or the fixture segment of a fixture allocation it expects to dispatch, is at such a place with a Human/Agent custodian; a move goes to another INTERNAL_STORAGE place.

prePickDispatch.meaning: A dispatch of an allocation that is never picked is rejected 'Pick before dispatch required' unless an earlier check decides it. Such a negative is accepted only when it pins a non-APPLIED outcome and a code whose earlier check the case itself shows (step2r round 10, closure review 7 P3): FORBIDDEN when the acting actor is no fixture actor, lacks dispatchQuantity in role or grant, has no grant valid at the clock of the dispatch or an earlier action revokes authority; VERSION_UNSUPPORTED when the request definitionVersion differs from the fixture definition; STALE_REVISION when an earlier dispatch, release or replacement of the same allocation consumed it, or the fixture declares the allocation CONSUMED, RELEASED or REPLACED. An expectedRevision mismatch, an INSUFFICIENT_ELIGIBLE_QUANTITY or a SCOPE_INELIGIBLE does not show that the check precedes the pick, so such a negative picks first.
prePickDispatch.unnamedAllocation: A dispatch that names no allocation is accepted only as a route-level denial: it pins /response/error/code FORBIDDEN and runs on the batch or worker route, or names a subject of another organization.

openInstallerConventions: Grant scope vocabulary (itemAliases, segmentAliases with derivedSegmentsWithinSamePhysicalRoot, workAliases, createdWorkNamespace, workKinds, sourceNamespaces, places): FixtureInstaller installs only an organization-wide scope today ('Dimension-restricted grant fixture mapping pending'). The WORK dimension of a runtime-created sales or purchase work has no fixture alias; the mapping is Step 3's.

Decision capabilities that fixtures list only in roleCapabilities (QC_DECIDE_RESTRICTION, MANAGER_*, ADMIN_*): PolicyCommandGuard checks the approver with permittedScopes, which needs a GrantAction of the decision capability.
The current COMMAND policy (PolicyCommandGuard.rule) and the published definition content (CommandDefinitionResolver) per capability are installer content derived from the fixture versions.
